note: Portfolio-management estimates for ARIS4C 000. Progress is not a scientific result; 100 means the current repository-level final output contract is satisfied. Activity is a live execution state with exactly four values: finish, active, wait, or block. Finish means the current final/output contract is complete. Active means meaningful research work is running now or has produced a recent substantive paper-folder update. Wait means the next meaningful step is executable but is not currently being advanced. Block means meaningful progress depends on an external/human/independent-review/data-transfer/permission or similar dependency. Metadata-only, README, Pages, and handoff-sync commits do not make a project Active.
